inj.note: Watson, who reported concussion symptoms Tuesday, didn't practice Wednesday or Thursday before being deemed limited Friday and subsequently heading into the weekend with a 'questionable' tag. Though Watson has cleared the NFL's concussion protocol, the Browns have elected to err on the side of caution with the QB who has compiled a 5-3 record as the team's starter to date. With Watson listed as inactive versus New Orleans, Shedeur Sanders will draw the start, while Dillon Gabriel will serve as Cleveland's No. 2 signal-caller. Taylen Green is the team's emergency No. 3 QB.

news.h: Browns QB Deshaun Watson out of protocol but inactive
news.d: Deshaun Watson has cleared the concussion protocol but the Browns quarterback is inactive for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.

news.h: Browns to start Sanders at QB vs. Saints with Watson in protocol
news.d: The Browns will start Shedeur Sanders at quarterback against the Saints as Deshaun Watson remains in the concussion protocol.

news.h: Browns QB Deshaun Watson in concussion protocol; status vs. Saints unclear
news.d: The Browns have placed starting QB Deshaun Watson in the concussion protocol, leaving his status for Sunday's matchup against the Saints in question.
